name: Mount Sanqingshan National Park
description: Mount Sanqingshan rises to 1,817 metres in China's northeastern Jiangxi Province, a Taoist sacred mountain named for its three main summits. Its slopes bristle with 48 granite peaks and 89 pillars, many shaped like people or animals. Waterfalls, forests and drifting clouds add to the scene, and the mist sometimes produces glowing halos and white rainbows.
